-- ref Blizzard_MacroUI.lua:1-5, verbatim. MAX_MACROS = 18 NUM_MACRO_ICONS_SHOWN = 20 NUM_ICONS_PER_ROW = 5 NUM_ICON_ROWS = 4 MACRO_ICON_ROW_HEIGHT = 36
-- The body box's own scroll sizing (this file's header comment). `letters="255"` caps the -- body, and the box is ~286 wide at GameFontHighlightSmall, so ~48 characters fit a line. -- The child height is `(explicit lines + wrap allowance) * line height`, which can only -- OVER-estimate — an over-estimate costs a little empty scroll room, an under-estimate -- clips text the player typed. BENILLA_MACRO_LINE_H = 14 BENILLA_MACRO_CHARS_PER_LINE = 48 BENILLA_MACRO_BODY_H = 85 -- the ref's own MacroFrameScrollFrame height (ref l.396)
function BenillaMacroFrameText_Resize() local box = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameText") local text = box:GetText() or "" local lines, pos = 1, 1 while true do local at = string.find(text, "\n", pos, true) if not at then break end lines, pos = lines + 1, at + 1 end local wrap = math.ceil(string.len(text) / BENILLA_MACRO_CHARS_PER_LINE) local h = (lines + wrap) * BENILLA_MACRO_LINE_H if h < BENILLA_MACRO_BODY_H then h = BENILLA_MACRO_BODY_H end box:SetHeight(h) local scroll = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameScrollFrame") scroll:UpdateScrollChildRect() BenillaScroll_SyncBar(scroll) end
function BenillaMacroFrameScrollFrame_OnLoad(scrollFrame) scrollFrame:SetScrollChild(getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameText")) BenillaScroll_SyncBar(scrollFrame) end
-- Tab 2's label is the ref's own `format(CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_MACROS, UnitName("player"))` -- (ref MacroFrame.xml l.509), re-derived on every show because the player name is not known -- at load time here. Guarded on the global string itself: a VM without GlobalStrings (the -- shipped-XML load test) must not die in an OnLoad. function BenillaMacroFrame_TabTwoLabel() if not CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_MACROS then return "Character" end return format(CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_MACROS, UnitName("player") or "") end
-- ref UIParent.lua:198-203. No LoadAddOn here: benilla has no load-on-demand addon layer, -- so the window is always loaded and this is a plain Show. function ShowMacroFrame() ShowUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame")) end

-- ref l.19-29. The OnHide save is the reference's own "closing the window commits the -- body you were typing" — the single most load-bearing line in this file. function BenillaMacroFrame_OnShow() BenillaMacroFrame_Update() PlaySound("igCharacterInfoOpen") end
function BenillaMacroFrame_OnHide() getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupFrame"):Hide() BenillaMacroFrame_SaveMacro() PlaySound("igCharacterInfoClose") end
-- ref l.31-49. function BenillaMacroFrame_SetAccountMacros() local frame = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame") frame.macroBase = 0 local numAccountMacros = GetNumMacros() if numAccountMacros > 0 then BenillaMacroFrame_SelectMacro(frame.macroBase + 1) else BenillaMacroFrame_SelectMacro(nil) end end
function BenillaMacroFrame_SetCharacterMacros() local frame = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame") frame.macroBase = MAX_MACROS local numAccountMacros, numCharacterMacros = GetNumMacros() if numCharacterMacros > 0 then BenillaMacroFrame_SelectMacro(frame.macroBase + 1) else BenillaMacroFrame_SelectMacro(nil) end end
-- DEVIATION (this window is always loaded; the ref's is LoadOnDemand). The ref's -- `MacroFrame_OnLoad` — which picks the first macro — runs the instant the addon loads, -- i.e. immediately before the first open, so it always sees the real macro table. Ours -- runs at boot, before the app has loaded a single macro from disk, so the selection has -- to be re-established whenever the table can have moved. One place: the top of _Update, -- which every show, every UPDATE_MACROS, every tab switch and every delete already runs -- through. A still-valid selection is left alone (reopening the window keeps your place, -- exactly as the ref's does). function BenillaMacroFrame_EnsureSelection() local frame = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame") local numAccount, numChar = GetNumMacros() local numMacros = numAccount if frame.macroBase ~= 0 then numMacros = numChar end local sel = frame.selectedMacro if sel and sel > frame.macroBase and sel <= (frame.macroBase + numMacros) then return end if numMacros > 0 then BenillaMacroFrame_SelectMacro(frame.macroBase + 1) else BenillaMacroFrame_SelectMacro(nil) end end
-- ref l.51-120, re-expressed. function BenillaMacroFrame_Update() BenillaMacroFrame_EnsureSelection() local frame = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame") local numAccountMacros, numCharacterMacros = GetNumMacros() local numMacros if frame.macroBase == 0 then numMacros = numAccountMacros else numMacros = numCharacterMacros end
for i = 1, MAX_MACROS do local macroButton = getglobal("BenillaMacroButton" .. i) local macroIcon = getglobal("BenillaMacroButton" .. i .. "Icon") local macroName = getglobal("BenillaMacroButton" .. i .. "Name") if i <= numMacros then local name, texture, body = GetMacroInfo(frame.macroBase + i) macroIcon:SetTexture(texture) macroName:SetText(name) macroButton:Enable() if frame.selectedMacro and (i == (frame.selectedMacro - frame.macroBase)) then macroButton:SetChecked(1) getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameSelectedMacroName"):SetText(name) getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameText"):SetText(body) getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameSelectedMacroButton"):SetID(i) getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameSelectedMacroButtonIcon"):SetTexture(texture) else macroButton:SetChecked(0) end else macroButton:SetChecked(0) macroIcon:SetTexture("") macroName:SetText("") macroButton:Disable() end end
if frame.selectedMacro ~= nil then BenillaMacroFrame_ShowDetails() else BenillaMacroFrame_HideDetails() end
if numMacros == MAX_MACROS then getglobal("BenillaMacroNewButton"):Disable() else getglobal("BenillaMacroNewButton"):Enable() end
if getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupFrame"):IsVisible() then getglobal("BenillaMacroEditButton"):Disable() getglobal("BenillaMacroDeleteButton"):Disable() else getglobal("BenillaMacroEditButton"):Enable() getglobal("BenillaMacroDeleteButton"):Enable() end
if not frame.selectedMacro then getglobal("BenillaMacroDeleteButton"):Disable() end -- The body's scroll range follows whatever SetText just put in the box. BenillaMacroFrameText_Resize() end
-- ref l.122-126. The engine calls nothing by this name; the spellbook's shift-click does -- (SpellBookFrame.xml, ref SpellBookFrame.lua:272-280) — the "shift click a spell in your -- spellbook with the macro UI open" line MACRO_HELP_TEXT_LINE5 advertises. function BenillaMacroFrame_AddMacroLine(line) local box = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameText") if box:IsVisible() then box:SetText((box:GetText() or "") .. line) getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame").textChanged = 1 BenillaMacroFrameText_Resize() end end

getglobal("BenillaMacroEditButton"):Disable() getglobal("BenillaMacroDeleteButton"):Disable() getglobal("BenillaMacroNewButton"):Disable() getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameTab1"):Disable() getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameTab2"):Disable() end

getglobal("BenillaMacroEditButton"):Enable() getglobal("BenillaMacroDeleteButton"):Enable() local numAccountMacros, numCharacterMacros = GetNumMacros() local numMacros if frame.macroBase == 0 then numMacros = numAccountMacros else numMacros = numCharacterMacros end if numMacros < MAX_MACROS then getglobal("BenillaMacroNewButton"):Enable() end PanelTemplates_UpdateTabs(frame) end
-- ref l.215-250, with ONE faithfulness note that is easy to get wrong. The ref's body -- opens `if ( this.mode == "new" ) then MacroPopupEditBox:SetText("")` — and `this` there -- is the FrameScript caller, not the popup: from `MacroPopupFrame_OnShow` it IS the popup -- (so a fresh "new" clears the name box), but from `MacroPopupButton_OnClick` it is the -- clicked BUTTON, whose `.mode` is nil, so neither branch runs and the name you already -- typed survives the icon click. Substituting the popup for `this` would blank the name on -- every icon click — the reference does not do that. Modelled explicitly instead: only the -- OnShow path asks for the name reset. function BenillaMacroPopupFrame_Update(resetName) local popup = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupFrame") local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupScrollFrame") local numMacroIcons = GetNumMacroIcons() local macroPopupOffset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame)
if resetName then if popup.mode == "new" then getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupEditBox"):SetText("") elseif popup.mode == "edit" then local name = GetMacroInfo(getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame").selectedMacro) getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupEditBox"):SetText(name or "") end end
for i = 1, NUM_MACRO_ICONS_SHOWN do local icon = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupButton" .. i .. "Icon") local button = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupButton" .. i) local index = (macroPopupOffset * NUM_ICONS_PER_ROW) + i if index <= numMacroIcons then icon:SetTexture(GetMacroIconInfo(index)) button:Show() else icon:SetTexture("") button:Hide() end if index == popup.selectedIcon then button:SetChecked(1) else button:SetChecked(nil) end end
FauxScrollFrame_Update(scrollFrame, math.ceil(numMacroIcons / NUM_ICONS_PER_ROW), NUM_ICON_ROWS, MACRO_ICON_ROW_HEIGHT) end
-- ref l.252-261. The "edit" arm's second Enable is the ref's own: renaming an existing -- macro does not require re-picking an icon. function BenillaMacroPopupOkayButton_Update() local popup = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupFrame") local okay = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupOkayButton") local text = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupEditBox"):GetText() or "" if string.len(text) > 0 and popup.selectedIcon then okay:Enable() else okay:Disable() end if popup.mode == "edit" and string.len(text) > 0 then okay:Enable() end end
-- ref l.263-268. function BenillaMacroPopupButton_OnClick(button) local popup = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupFrame") local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupScrollFrame") popup.selectedIcon = button:GetID() + (FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame) * NUM_ICONS_PER_ROW) getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameSelectedMacroButtonIcon") :SetTexture(GetMacroIconInfo(popup.selectedIcon)) BenillaMacroPopupOkayButton_Update() BenillaMacroPopupFrame_Update() end
-- ref l.270-280. `perCharacter` is the ref's own `(MacroFrame.macroBase > 0)`. function BenillaMacroPopupOkayButton_OnClick() local frame = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame") local popup = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupFrame") local name = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupEditBox"):GetText() local index = 1 if popup.mode == "new" then index = CreateMacro(name, popup.selectedIcon, nil, nil, (frame.macroBase > 0)) elseif popup.mode == "edit" then index = EditMacro(frame.selectedMacro, name, popup.selectedIcon) end popup:Hide() BenillaMacroFrame_SelectMacro(index) BenillaMacroFrame_Update() end
-- ref l.282-287. function BenillaMacroFrame_SaveMacro() local frame = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame") if frame.textChanged and frame.selectedMacro then EditMacro(frame.selectedMacro, nil, nil, getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameText"):GetText()) frame.textChanged = nil end end
-- The body box's OnTextChanged (ref MacroFrame.xml l.411-427): mark dirty, close a "new" -- popup, refresh the character counter, and keep the view pinned to the bottom while -- typing (the ref's own scrollBar:SetValue(max) tail). function BenillaMacroFrameText_OnTextChanged(box) local frame = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame") frame.textChanged = 1 local popup = getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupFrame") if popup.mode == "new" then popup:Hide() end getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameCharLimitText") :SetText(format(MACROFRAME_CHAR_LIMIT, box:GetNumLetters())) BenillaMacroFrameText_Resize() local bar = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameScrollFrameBar") local _, maxValue = bar:GetMinMaxValues() if maxValue > 0 and box.maxScroll ~= maxValue then box.maxScroll = maxValue bar:SetValue(maxValue) end end
-- The window's own event driver: UPDATE_MACROS is the ref's event for "the macro table -- changed" and covers BOTH an edit made here and the app's load at world entry, so a -- freshly-entered world shows the saved macros without this file knowing about files. function BenillaMacroFrame_OnEvent(frame, event) if event == "UPDATE_MACROS" then BenillaMacroFrame_EnsureSelection() if frame:IsVisible() then BenillaMacroFrame_Update() end end end

Scripts.OnClick: -- The ref relies on the button being Disabled (MacroFrame_Update) to keep -- `selectedMacro` non-nil here; guard anyway — a script Click() bypasses -- the disabled state and DeleteMacro(nil) is a hard error, not a no-op. if not getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame").selectedMacro then return end DeleteMacro(getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame").selectedMacro) BenillaMacroFrame_SetAccountMacros() if getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame").macroBase ~= 0 then BenillaMacroFrame_SetCharacterMacros() end BenillaMacroFrame_Update() getglobal("BenillaMacroFrameText"):ClearFocus()

Scripts.OnEnterPressed: -- The ref writes `IsEnabled() ~= 0`; this engine's IsEnabled returns -- a BOOLEAN (button.rs), for which `~= 0` is always true — plain -- truthiness is the correct read here. if getglobal("BenillaMacroPopupOkayButton"):IsEnabled() then BenillaMacroPopupOkayButton_OnClick() end
